title: Top Industrial Automation Companies in the World: 2026 Rankings and What They Do
text:
Industrial  automation  is growing rapidly across the world as industries move toward smarter, safer, and more efficient operations. Whether it’s manufacturing, oil & gas, water treatment, food processing, or power generation, automation technologies help plants operate faster and with fewer errors.
 For students and fresh engineers in instrumentation, understanding the top global automation companies is extremely useful. It gives clarity on career opportunities, new technologies, and the type of instruments used in real industries.
 Many leading automation companies not only dominate worldwide but also have a strong presence in the USA, making them ideal employers for engineering graduates.
 When students begin exploring the industry, understanding how major automation companies operate helps them choose the right skills and certifications. The global market for automation companies continues to expand as industries adopt digital technologies, robotics, and smart manufacturing systems.
 Although this article is not covering technical topic but covers companies worldwide , we highlight their influence and presence in the USA , because it is one of the largest automation markets in the world.
 Let us explore the top 10 industrial automation companies globally.
 1. Siemens (Germany)
 Website: https://www.siemens.com 
 Siemens is one of the most powerful and respected automation companies in the world. Their technologies cover almost every industry, from manufacturing to pharmaceuticals and power plants.
 Why Siemens is global leader: 
 S7 PLC systems 
 TIA Portal engineering software 
 Process automation, drives, motors 
 Digital manufacturing and industrial IoT 
 Focus on the USA: Siemens has a huge presence in the United States, with facilities, engineering centers, and thousands of automation installations across the country.
 2. Rockwell Automation / Allen-Bradley (USA)
 Website: https://www.rockwellautomation.com 
 Rockwell Automation is the leading American automation company , known especially for Allen-Bradley PLCs. In the USA, it is the most widely used automation brand in manufacturing, automotive plants, packaging, food processing, and consumer goods industries.
 Why Rockwell stands out: 
 ControlLogix, CompactLogix PLCs 
 FactoryTalk SCADA 
 Drives, safety systems, industrial controllers 
 Global strength: Rockwell is growing strongly worldwide due to its easy-to-learn programming and strong software ecosystem.
 3. ABB (Switzerland)
 Website: https://www.abb.com 
 ABB is a global automation and robotics leader. Their robots, drives, and automation systems are used across industries.
 Key technologies: 
 ABB 800xA DCS 
 Robotics and motion control 
 Industrial electrification and drives 
 Smart sensors and IIoT products 
 USA relevance: ABB Robotics USA is among the strongest automation robotics suppliers for American automotive plants.
 4. Schneider Electric (France)
 Website: https://www.se.com 
 Schneider Electric is known for energy management and automation solutions. Their technologies are heavily used in manufacturing, infrastructure, buildings, and water treatment.
 Popular products: 
 Modicon PLCs 
 SCADA and HMI systems 
 Drives, power management systems 
 AVEVA & Wonderware software 
 US Market Presence: AVEVA (Wonderware), acquired by Schneider, is extremely popular among American automation engineers.
 5. Emerson (USA)
 Website: https://www.emerson.com 
 Emerson Automation Solutions is one of the largest process automation companies globally. Their pressure, flow, temperature, and level transmitters are trusted in harsh industrial environments.
 Key technologies: 
 DeltaV DCS 
 Rosemount transmitters 
 Control valves and final control systems 
 Plant reliability and IIoT solutions 
 US Strength: Emerson is headquartered in the USA and is heavily used in oil & gas, chemical, power, and energy sectors.
 6. Honeywell Process Solutions (USA)
 Website: https://www.honeywellprocess.com 
 Honeywell is a pioneer in both building automation and industrial automation. Their systems are commonly found in refineries and chemical plants.
 Technologies: 
 Experion DCS 
 Safety systems (SIS) 
 Advanced process control 
 Industrial cybersecurity systems 
 USA dominance: Honeywell is one of the most trusted automation brands in North American oil & gas facilities.
 7. Mitsubishi Electric (Japan)
 Website: https://www.mitsubishielectric.com 
 Mitsubishi is a global leader in factory automation and is widely used in automotive manufacturing, packaging, and electronics.
 Products: 
 MELSEC PLCs 
 Robots & servo systems 
 CNC controllers 
 Automation software 
 USA relevance: American factories, especially in automotive and packaging industries, use Mitsubishi PLCs for machine automation.
 8. Yokogawa (Japan)
 Website: https://www.yokogawa.com 
 Yokogawa is known for high-quality instrumentation and control systems, especially for process industries.
 Core technologies: 
 CENTUM DCS 
 ProSafe-RS safety systems 
 Pressure, temperature, and flow transmitters 
 Advanced control and analytics 
 Presence in USA: Yokogawa USA supplies automation systems to LNG plants, refineries, and petrochemical industries.
 9. OMRON Automation (Japan)
 Website: https://automation.omron.com 
 OMRON focuses on smart machine automation, robotics, machine vision, and safety systems.
 Major technologies: 
 Machine vision cameras 
 Robotic systems 
 Safety controllers 
 PLCs and industrial sensors 
 USA demand: OMRON Automation Americas supports many US manufacturing companies in electronics and packaging.
 10. FANUC (Japan)
 Website: https://www.fanucamerica.com 
 FANUC is the world’s largest industrial robotics manufacturer and a dominant force in factory automation.
 Why FANUC is global leader: 
 CNC systems 
 Robotic arms for manufacturing 
 Collaborative robots (cobots) 
 Motion control technology
